<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="kPWnt5IU3aNYHInCkAmv"> <mxGraphModel dx="1623" dy="1231" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
	autonumber
	participant Sch as OutboxScheduler<br/>(auth-service)
	participant OES as OutboxEvent<br/>ServiceImpl
	participant ORepo as OutboxEvent<br/>Repository
	participant Pub as OutboxKafka<br/>Publisher
	participant Kafka as Kafka topic:<br/>auth.events

	loop every outbox.publisher.delay-ms
		Sch->>OES: publishNextBatch(batchSize)
		OES->>ORepo: reclaimStalePublishing(now,<br/>NEW, PUBLISHING)
		OES->>ORepo: findNextBatch(NEW, now, page)

		loop each outbox event
			OES->>ORepo: claimNewEvent(eventId,<br/>claimedAt, claimUntil,<br/>PUBLISHING, NEW)
			alt claim succeeded
				OES->>Pub: publishAsync(outboxEvent)
				Pub->>Kafka: send(payload + headers)

				alt publish success
					OES->>ORepo: markPublished(eventId,<br/>now, PUBLISHED)
				else publish failure
					alt backoffPolicy.shouldFail(nextRetryCount)
						OES->>ORepo: markFailed(eventId,<br/>retryCount, error, FAILED)
					else retry later
						OES->>ORepo: markRetry(eventId,<br/>retryCount, nextAttemptAt,<br/>error, NEW)
					end
				end
			else claim lost
				Note over OES,ORepo: another poller instance already claimed it
			end
		end
	end


",
 "config": null
}" id="OIQvXJK3jxkEPSnIfM8--48"> <mxCell connectable="0" parent="1" style="group;transparentBounds=1;editIcon=1;lockedGroup=0;groupPadding=10;labelBackgroundColor=none;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="OutboxScheduler
